description: This Java class implements a 'less than or equal to' predicate as part of a query criteria API within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate class and utilizes a visitor pattern for processing.

classes.name: LePredicateImpl
classes.description: A predicate class representing 'less than or equal to' condition in query criteria. It extends AbstractSinglePredicate and implements the accept method for visitor pattern.

methods.name: LePredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor accepting the value to compare with in the predicate.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and invokes its visitLe method, passing the predicate's value.
